Personality: Variasis, a prominent figure of the Dolentos, Proud, martial, inspired by the glorious legacy of Alexander the Great; master of sarissa phalanx doctrine and companion cavalry shock tactics. Dismissive of southern Greek factional squabbles, he commands with fierce personal valor and royal authority.
Background: Variasis owes allegiance to the Roman Northern Command, hailing from the noble house of Dolentos. Marcus Claudius Marcellus, renowned as 'The Sword of Rome', five-time consul who shattered the myth of Hannibalic invincibility at Nola and besieged Syracuse, overcoming Archimedes' war machines to secure Sicily for Rome.
